# Roman Baranenko

> Roman Baranenko is a software engineer and the Platform Owner at WAVEIX. A blog about software architecture and business, a CV and contacts.

Every page has a Markdown version at the same address: the URL without the trailing slash plus `.md`, for example `https://roma-bb8.github.io/blog/` is `https://roma-bb8.github.io/blog.md`. The site is available in English and Ukrainian (`/uk/`). All content is static; there is no API.

## Main

- [Home](https://roma-bb8.github.io/index.md): who I am, numbers, products, contacts
- [CV](https://roma-bb8.github.io/cv.md): experience, education, skills
- [Головна (українською)](https://roma-bb8.github.io/uk/index.md): те саме українською
- [CV (українською)](https://roma-bb8.github.io/uk/cv.md)
